name: VP Bank AG
summary: VP Bank AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services in Liechtenstein, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Liechtenstein and BVI, International, and Asset Servicing. It offers investing services, including goal-based advice, wealth management and planning, investment advisory and consulting, investment products, and sustainable investing; mortgage loans and real estate financing, as well as Lombard loan; private label funds; exchange rates; and execution only services.
